summary: First E2E test of TrustMule (Expo/RN + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 35/35 pytest tests passed covering full escrow lifecycle (offer→respond→stake→fund→purchased→transit→arrived→qr→complete) with balance/lock/release/platform-fee (3%)/stake-return (15%) math verified, plus auth, KYC, wallet faucet, requests CRUD, filters, reviews (+dup rejection + reputation update), disputes, chat (participants-only guard), order/message authorization guards, cancel refund flow, and Emergent Object Storage upload+serve. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login (Continue with Google → name/email inputs), Explore feed with 4+ seeded requests, category tabs, search filter ("Sony" filters correctly), Wallet ($0.00 → deposit $1500 → $1,500.00), Orders empty state, Profile with KYC + Logout, KYC screen loads, Post-request form renders all fields correctly. No React Native red screens. No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) present.

ui_bugs.issue: Individual request cards in the feed have no testID (e.g. request-card-<id>) making it impossible to reliably tap a specific card for detail navigation in automation. Add testID={`request-card-${item.id}`} on the card TouchableOpacity.

Tapping `from-country`/`to-country` opens a picker but the options are not reliably interactable on web preview – 'text=United States' resolves but was reported not visible; picker unexpectedly ended up with 'Germany' selected without an explicit tap, suggesting keyboard/scroll auto-select. Consider giving each country row a stable testID like country-option-<code> and ensuring the modal option list is visible in the mobile viewport.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated to keep console clean and future-proof RN Web.

action_items: Add testID to each request card in explore.tsx (e.g. `request-card-${item.id}`) so automation and future testers can tap into request detail.

Add testID to country picker options (country-option-<name>) and confirm the picker modal is fully visible/scrollable on 390x844 mobile viewport; verify option selection isn't affected by keyboard focus.
Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' (or Platform.select) to clear RN-Web console warnings.
(Nice-to-have) Add testIDs to bottom tab-bar items (tab-explore/tab-orders/tab-wallet/tab-profile) so automation doesn't have to fall back to text= selectors that hit tab-label duplicates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 800 lines and contains all routes; consider splitting into routers (auth, orders, wallet, chat, reviews, disputes) for maintainability once >700 lines.
PATCH /users/me uses body.dict() (deprecated in Pydantic v2); switch to body.model_dump(exclude_none=True) for forward-compat.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to a lifespan handler.
In `_settle`, buyer's `ordersCompleted` is incremented in a separate update_one call after the traveler update – fine but a single $inc combining fields would be cheaper; not blocking.

Cancel logic: when traveler cancels while status is 'agreed' (buyerFunded=True already via _maybe_fund), stake is slashed 50%. Behaviour is defensible but should be documented in-app so travelers aren't surprised.
public_user does not expose usdcBalance/lockedBalance — good (no PII leak) — but /api/wallet always returns caller's balance; verified. No leakage detected.
Login endpoint re-uses existing token when found; consider rotating token on each login for stronger security (currently OK for preview).
No rate-limiting or CORS restriction (allow_origins=['*']); acceptable for preview.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (login, explore feed, filter, wallet deposit, orders, profile, kyc navigation all working; country picker in post form needs testID work for full automation)

seed_data_creation: Created test buyer/traveler/stranger accounts via /api/auth/login with timestamped emails; deposited faucet USDC; created several TEST_ prefixed requests + orders. Seeded requests already provided by backend startup (4 demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid – reuse /app/backend/tests/test_trustmule_backend.py (single-class shared state via cls attributes to be xdist loadscope-safe). Frontend testIDs are mostly good; the two gaps are (a) per-request-card testIDs on Explore and (b) country picker option testIDs. Login is two-step (tap Continue with Google → enter name+email → submit). Web preview escrow uses managed backend (chain.live=false); this is intentional per PRD.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no bugs found. All money-flow math (item+fee locked, 3% platform fee, 15% stake return, cancel refunds) verified end-to-end via pytest.
